# Pixel Virtual Pet

A simple offline browser app where you take care of a CSS-drawn pixel creature. Keep its hunger, happiness, and energy bars in check using the Feed, Play, and Sleep buttons. The mood text updates based on the average of the three stats.

## Features

- CSS-drawn pixel pet with expressive mood text.
- Three stat bars: Hunger, Happiness, Energy.
- Buttons: Feed (increases hunger, decreases energy), Play (increases happiness, decreases energy and hunger), Sleep (increases energy, decreases hunger and happiness).
- All controls are keyboard-accessible with visible focus states.
- Responsive layout from 360px wide.
- No external dependencies, works completely offline.

## How to Run

1. Open `index.html` in any modern web browser.
2. Use the buttons to interact with your pet.

## Technologies

- HTML5
- CSS3 (custom properties, flexbox, transitions)
- Vanilla JavaScript (ES6)
